answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can transact. The kernel of sybil resistance is that identity turns costly: each fake persona needs its own locked bond, so spawning a thousand clones locks a thousand stakes. Reputation then accrues glacier-slow, earned only through honest settled work, so a cheaply minted copy starts at the bottom ledge with nothing. An attacker must fund and age every identity, making a swarm of fakes economically pointless.
